Container.Name: roon-playlist-automation
Container.Overview:
Automatically maintains playlists in Roon from Pitchfork Best New Music and Aquarium Drunkard's Spotify playlists. Roon's API cannot create playlists, so this syncs picks into a TIDAL (or Qobuz) playlist, which Roon then imports from your linked streaming account.
Setup: 1. Create a TIDAL app at developer.tidal.com/dashboard with redirect URI http://127.0.0.1:8976/callback and paste the client ID below. 2. Create a Spotify app at developer.spotify.com/dashboard (read-only; used to mirror Aquarium Drunkard playlists) and paste its ID/secret below. 3. List the Aquarium Drunkard Spotify playlist IDs to mirror (comma-separated). 4. Start the container, open its console, and run: node src/index.js auth-tidal (one-time TIDAL login — see the project's UNRAID.md for the SSH-tunnel step, or copy a tidal-tokens.json created on your desktop into the data share).
Syncs on start and then every LOOP_INTERVAL_HOURS.

Config.Name: Data (tokens and sync state)
Config.Description: Stores TIDAL tokens and which tracks were already added.

Config.Name: TIDAL auth callback port
Config.Description: Only used during the one-time 'auth-tidal' login.

Config.Name: TIDAL_CLIENT_ID
Config.Description: Client ID of your app from developer.tidal.com/dashboard (add redirect URI http://127.0.0.1:8976/callback to the app).

Config.Name: SPOTIFY_CLIENT_ID
Config.Description: Spotify app client ID (developer.spotify.com/dashboard). Needed for the Aquarium Drunkard mirror.

Config.Name: AD_SPOTIFY_PLAYLIST_IDS
Config.Description: Comma-separated Spotify playlist IDs to mirror (the part after /playlist/ in a share link). Find Aquarium Drunkard's at open.spotify.com/user/aquariumdrunkard.

Config.Name: PROVIDER
Config.Description: Where the playlists are created: tidal or qobuz.

Config.Name: PITCHFORK_ENABLED
Config.Description: Maintain the Pitchfork: Best New Music playlist.

Config.Name: PITCHFORK_INCLUDE_ALBUMS
Config.Description: Expand Best New Albums into their tracks.

Config.Name: PITCHFORK_MAX_TRACKS_PER_ALBUM
Config.Description: Cap tracks added per BNM album (0 = all).

Config.Name: AD_PLAYLIST_NAME
Config.Description: Name of the Aquarium Drunkard playlist.
